message.content:
Oh, that’s a mess—there’s no standard. We’ve got drones with all kinds of connectors: some use the old-style XT60, others have the newer DJI-style plugs, and a few have these weird proprietary ones that only fit their own chargers.

The worst part? You can’t just swap a battery between drones—if the connector doesn’t match the pad, it won’t charge. So if a drone’s battery dies and the wrong pad’s free, we’re stuck waiting until the right one opens up. And if a pad’s down for maintenance? Total nightmare.

The software should at least tell us which pad matches which drone, but right now we’ve got to check that manually. And if a drone’s connector gets damaged? That’s a whole other headache—sometimes we’ve got to send a tech out just to fix a charging issue.
